title: ErrorData
description: The data of a control error: the launcher's code for the failure, one of protocol/specs/src/errors/codes.json's control group, and what a client can act on. A request's failure is never only a message.

code.description: Why the request failed: a code of the control group of protocol/specs/src/errors/codes.json.

retryable.description: Whether the same request can succeed sent again unchanged, once something outside it changes: a start finishes, a runtime is installed, a stack comes up.

fields.description: For params the contract refuses: each fault, where it is.

choices.description: For control.target-required and control.target-ambiguous: each target the request could have meant, to send again with one.

supported.description: For control.unsupported-api-version: each version this launcher speaks.

mayStillRun.description: For a cancelled stack.start: whether services the start launched may still be running. The launcher stops waiting, and stops nothing.
